channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: New Ukrainian GCSE welcomed for Rochdale pupils
item.description: Rochdale MP Paul Waugh has welcomed plans for a Ukrainian GCSE, with teaching expected from September 2028 and first exams in 2029.

item.title: Cinderella panto set to enchant audiences at Middleton Arena this Christmas
item.description: Panto-goers in Middleton will soon be treated to a magical rendition of Cinderella at Middleton Arena, starting December 20. The production features Becca Elizabeth-Davies as Cinderella and Tom Sentia as Prince Charming, who embarks on a quest to find the owner of a special glass slipper.

item.title: Cronkeyshaw Common bonfire night proves a huge success as quiet fireworks light up the sky
item.description: Quiet fireworks set to music including Queen’s Don’t Stop Me Now have delighted the crowd at Cronkeyshaw Common, with little to no traffic disruption reported so far.

item.title: EG On The Move plans to rebuild Rochdale forecourt
item.description: EG On The Move is set to demolish and rebuild a filling station in Rochdale as part of its growth strategy.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards contract for Empty Homes Leasing Programme
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a contract to CAREPOINT HC LIMITED for the GM Empty Homes TA Leasing Programme, aimed at providing temporary accommodation for families.

item.title: Falinge Park High School students participate in fire-spinning workshops
item.description: Ten Year 9 and 10 students from Falinge Park High School took part in fire-spinning workshops with Skylight Circus Arts, preparing for the Rochdale Ignite Fire Festival.

item.title: Did goblins move Rochdale Parish Church up the hill?
item.description: A long-told local tale says unseen workers carried building stones overnight to the top of the hill; the record shows a medieval church, later Victorian work, and a 19th‑century storyteller rather than supernatural masons.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 4 November 2026
item.description: A quiet night in the borough — nothing new published since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale Leisure Centre small pool closed for repairs
item.description: The small pool at Rochdale Leisure Centre is closed until further notice due to a technical issue with its movable floor, affecting scheduled sessions.

item.title: New plans for Greggs bakery at Littleborough Service Station
item.description: Motor Fuel Group has submitted a planning application to Rochdale Council to establish a Greggs bakery at Littleborough Service Station, creating new jobs and utilising existing buildings.

item.title: Asda worker Saheda Bibi praised for supporting widowed customer in Rochdale
item.description: Saheda Bibi, an Asda employee in Rochdale, has been recognised for her kindness in helping a recently widowed customer with her shopping needs.

item.title: Rochdale AFC eliminated from Jersey Mike’s Trophy after 4-1 defeat to Doncaster Rovers
item.description: Rochdale AFC faced a disappointing exit from the Jersey Mike’s Trophy, losing 4-1 to Doncaster Rovers at home on Tuesday evening.

item.title: Hopwood Hall College partners with Rochdale AFC to enhance football education
item.description: Hopwood Hall College has announced a partnership with Rochdale AFC to offer a new BTEC Sport with Football qualification starting in September 2027, providing students with unique opportunities in the football industry.

item.title: Investigation works begin at former Turner Brothers factory site in Rochdale
item.description: Spodden Park Ltd has started investigations to locate buried asbestos at the derelict Turner Brothers factory, aiming for future redevelopment.

item.title: Zambrero to give away free burritos at new Mellor Street restaurant in Rochdale
item.description: Zambrero will hand out hundreds of free burritos and bowls from 11am to 2pm on Thursday 12 November to mark its new Mellor Street restaurant, which opened in September.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards contract for new income management system
item.description: Civica UK Limited has been awarded a contract by Rochdale Borough Council for an income management system to enhance payment processing.

item.title: Ian Henderson breaks Rochdale AFC appearance record
item.description: Ian Henderson will break the club record for appearances during the match against Newport County on Tuesday evening.

item.title: Rochdale AFC outlines youth development strategy
item.description: Rochdale AFC has launched a new initiative to enhance its youth development programme, aiming to create a pathway for young players to progress to the first team.

item.title: Rochdale Council leaves door open for Hopwood Hall reconciliation after court ruling
item.description: Following a recent High Court ruling, Rochdale Council has expressed willingness to engage with filmmaker Hopwood DePree regarding the future of Hopwood Hall, which has been a point of contention since the termination of their agreement in 2024.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 3 November 2026
item.description: 4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Does a boggart still haunt Clegg Hall?
item.description: Clegg Hall’s stone house and its Grade II* listing are facts; the boggart is a long‑lived story with no contemporary record to prove the medieval murder it’s said to haunt.

item.title: Rochdale Town Centre to host community audio walk event
item.description: The event titled 'Stories We Tell: Rochdale' will take place in the town centre, featuring local community stories and themes of belonging.

item.title: Rochdale achieves 21 gold awards at North West in Bloom
item.description: Rochdale has celebrated a successful year at the North West in Bloom awards, achieving 21 gold awards and multiple category wins, including Best Town Centre.

item.title: Rochdale Asda worker's kindness a 'breath of fresh air' for widowed customer
item.description: Shaheda times her help around an older customer's shopping trips after the woman lost her husband, scanning and packing her shopping and stopping for a chat.

item.title: Three-year-old boy remains critical in hospital after incident at Middleton nursery
item.description: A three-year-old boy is in critical condition following a medical emergency at Cosy Toes nursery in Middleton, with police confirming the incident is not suspicious.

item.title: Union Street, roadworks in Rochdale from 17 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Dane Street in Rochdale; expected timings: Work began at 12midnight on Monday, 2 November 2026 and will continue for a maximum of 21 days (23 November 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Banned driver leads police on high-speed chase through Rochdale
item.description: A banned driver was involved in a high-speed chase through Rochdale, raising concerns about road safety in the area.

item.title: Eighth arrest in property damage investigation covering Rochdale
item.description: GMP says Rochdale is among six areas where properties were damaged during October. A 29-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of conspiracy to commit criminal damage.

item.title: Rochdale man Richard Townsend on trial for alleged abuse of unconscious wife
item.description: Richard Townsend, 37, from Heywood, is one of nine men accused of participating in the alleged drugging and sexual abuse of a woman by her husband.

item.title: Rochdale driver jailed for 16 months after dangerous police pursuit
item.description: Bilal Ishaq admitted four driving offences after a pursuit through Rochdale. Police say he ran red lights and twice tried to reverse into pursuing vehicles.

item.title: Rochdale prepares for return of popular ale trail event
item.description: Rochdale is gearing up for the return of its popular Ale Trail, an event designed to promote local hospitality and encourage community engagement. Participants will have the opportunity to explore various venues across the town centre while enjoying a selection of real ales. Scheduled for the weekend of November 12-13, the Ale Trail invites locals and…

item.title: Middleton care worker celebrated after 27 years at Langfield Care Home
item.description: Karen Haycock, who joined Langfield Care Home in Langley in May 1999, was surprised by colleagues and residents marking what the home calls 10,000 days of service.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 2 November 2026
item.description: 4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Free play sessions for young children in Littleborough and Middleton this week
item.description: Littleborough Library has a free under-fives session on Tuesday 3 November, while Junction Library in Middleton is advertising Saturday Lego and Duplo play for children aged two and over.

item.title: Rochdale to review future primary and secondary school place needs on 24 November
item.description: The council's forward plan schedules reports on primary places through 2030 and secondary places through 2031, alongside high-needs investment, for its 24 November cabinet meeting.

item.title: Sandbrook Way KFC licence now permits late-night service until 5am
item.description: Rochdale's public licensing register shows updated permission for late-night refreshment at the Sandbrook Way KFC, with the restaurant area due to close at midnight under a licence condition.

item.title: Littleborough Christmas lights: Church Street restrictions confirmed for 28 November
item.description: Church Street restrictions are planned for Littleborough's Christmas lights event on Saturday 28 November, including a daytime waiting ban and an afternoon road closure.

item.title: Rochdale reception school applications for 2027: deadline, preferences and offer dates
item.description: Parents applying for a Rochdale borough reception place starting September 2027 have until 15 January. The council has also confirmed the offer date and rules for school preferences.

item.title: Missed the secondary school deadline in Rochdale? What parents need to do next
item.description: Rochdale's 31 October deadline has passed, but families can still apply for a Year 7 place for September 2027. Here is how late applications are handled and when offers are expected.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards contract for family temporary accommodation services
item.description: The Bond Board Limited has been awarded a contract to manage the Homeless Family Leasing Scheme, providing vital support to homeless families in Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale Council approves new Storage World building in Middleton
item.description: Rochdale Council has approved plans for a new Storage World building in Middleton, following a fire that destroyed the previous structure.

item.title: Mark Winstanley returns to stage after MS diagnosis for Rochdale comedy show
item.description: Actor Mark Winstanley will perform in 'Cabaret Schmabaret' at the Ukrainian Centre on 19 November, marking his return to the stage after a five-year hiatus due to multiple sclerosis.

item.title: Rochdale's Atom Valley project aims to create thousands of jobs and homes
item.description: The Atom Valley development aims to create 17 million square feet of employment space and 7,000 new homes in Rochdale, with the first phase already underway.

item.title: Rochdale Sixth Form College to host Open Evening on 19 November
item.description: Prospective students and families are invited to explore courses and meet staff at Rochdale Sixth Form College's Open Evening.

item.title: Rochdale and Bury see significant increases in driving test pass rates
item.description: Driving test pass rates in Rochdale and Bury have seen notable increases, with Bury recording a six percentage point rise.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 1 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale remembers as community gathers for Remembrance Day services
item.description: Members of the public are invited to attend the Remembrance Day services on 8 November 2026, supported by the council.

item.title: Roadworks on Smithy Bridge Road in Littleborough scheduled for 15 November 2026
item.description: Temporary road closures will affect Smithy Bridge Road and surrounding areas during early hours on 15 November 2026.

item.title: Port Vale defeats Rochdale 4-2 in exciting encounter
item.description: Port Vale secured a 4-2 victory over Rochdale, with Onel Hernandez playing a key role in the match.

item.title: Rochdale residents return home after gas leak caused by car crash
item.description: Residents evacuated from Halifax Road in Rochdale can now return home after emergency services contained a gas leak following a car crash.
